Firefox lets you find a specific tab when you have a lot of tabs open:
#Click the ''List all tabs'' [[Image:tab icon 2|width=16]] button at the end of the tab strip.
#;{for not fx154}[[Image:step_1_tabs]]{/for} {note}'''Note:''' If [[Use the sidebar to access tools and vertical tabs|Vertical Tabs]] are enabled, click the ''List all tabs'' [[Image:Fx138VerticalListAllTabs]] button in the toolbar.{/note}
#Click {for not fx154}{menu Search tabs}{/for}{for fx154}{menu Search All Tabs}{/for} in the [[Tab overview menu|tab overview menu]] that opens.
#;{for not fx154}[[Image:step_2_tabs]]{/for}{for fx154}[[Image:Fx154TabOverviewMenu-Search]]{/for}
You can also find specific tabs using the address bar. Type a {key %} before or after your search term to filter the results to only open tabs.
